title: GenData — AI-Powered Synthetic Data Generation
summary: A full-stack platform (Next.js frontend, FastAPI backend) that generates realistic, privacy-safe synthetic tabular datasets from documents or natural-language prompts across domains like healthcare, finance, agriculture, and cybersecurity. It calls SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer via SingleTableMetadata to statistically model and sample synthetic rows from a reference dataset.
evidence: backend/app/engines/sdv_config.py:91-101 instantiates CTGANSynthesizer/TVAESynthesizer; generator.py:2051 fits/samples GaussianCopulaSynthesizer
